name: Korvain Dynamics TactilEdge Combat Gloves
description:
Reinforced tactical gloves with hardened knuckle plates, palm-grip texturing, and articulated finger joints that allow full dexterity while providing impact protection. The back of each hand features a mounting point for accessory modules — flashlights, data jacks, biometric readers.

Standard issue for Korvain's private military contracts and widely adopted by independent security operators who need their hands to do more than just hold a weapon.
functionality: Impact protection, accessory mounting, full dexterity retention
what_it_says: Your hands are tools of controlled violence and you've equipped them accordingly.
story_hooks: A pair of TactilEdge gloves found at a crime scene have the biometric reader module still active — and it contains the fingerprints of its last three 'clients.'

physical_description.visual_profile: Aggressive, purposeful tactical gloves that command attention on the wrist. Sharp silhouette with pronounced knuckle reinforcement creating a slightly clawed, weaponized appearance. The modular mounting points on the back of each hand read as industrial hard points rather than fashion accessories.
physical_description.fit: Snug, compression-fit construction that molds to hand contours without restricting finger movement. Articulated knuckle design allows full flexion and extension. Wrist cuff sits firmly mid-forearm with subtle taper.
physical_description.primary_material: Ballistic weave base layer with hardened polymer knuckle plates, reinforced synthetic leather palm overlay, and impact-absorbing gel padding in strike zones
physical_description.texture: Textured palm grip with micro-ridged pattern for weapon handling; smooth hardened knuckle plates with subtle hexagonal scoring; matte finish on dorsal surface with micro-texture
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal grey primary with jet black reinforced panels. Mounting points anodized gunmetal. Subtle Korvain Dynamics branding in reflective grey on wrist.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic friction-fit wrist closure with secondary velcro retention strap; integrated pressure-lock system at base of fingers
distinctive_features: Hardened polymer knuckle plates with impact optimization geometry
Dual modular mounting points on each dorsal hand surface (quick-attach rail system)
Articulated finger joint reinforcement allowing full tactical dexterity
Palm-grip texturing optimized for weapon handling in wet/synthetic conditions
Integrated haptic feedback zones for data jack compatibility
Reflective Korvain logo on wrist; discrete serial number
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corporate military equipment, aspirational Tier 3 street operator aesthetics
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals private security background, corpo military contract service, or independent combat operator. Worn by those who treat their hands as weapons and tools equally. Statement piece for street operators wanting to project capability and resources.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically pristine to lightly battle-worn; micro-scuffs on knuckle plates from genuine use; palm grip texture naturally darkens with handling oil and sweat

image_prompt: Professional tactical glove photography: matte charcoal Korvain Dynamics combat gloves displayed on dark chrome mannequin hands, positioned with fingers slightly spread to show articulated joint work and textured palm grip. Gunmetal mounting points catch moody blue-grey overhead lighting. Dark urban warehouse backdrop with geometric shadow play across the glove surface.
